claim: Demo changes and Reset affect only the separate demo data.
sandbox: Seed normal IndexedDB, change and reset /?demo=1, assert demo clears and normal data is byte-for-byte unchanged.

claim: The complete three-choice sample opens without setup or payment.
where: Landing first-screen outcome and fact, README
sandbox: Fresh context, one click from / to /demo; assert exactly three playable choices and the absence of checkout or payment controls.

claim: Browser-saved drills work offline after the first visit.
where: Landing first-screen fact, README, offline status
sandbox: Fresh context; seed and open a normal drill, wait for the worker, disconnect, reload its player, and make a choice.

claim: Authored text, photos, attempts, imports, exports, and deletion stay in browser storage.
sandbox: Fresh normal context; author with photo, complete, export, reload, delete, import, inspect IndexedDB, and reject external requests.

claim: The app has no accounts, ads, analytics, or network requests to other companies.
sandbox: Fresh context; inspect every public, dynamic, and 404 route for account or advertising controls while recording every request and loaded runtime resource.

claim: Learners see choice feedback, a debrief, and can replay.
sandbox: Complete the sample through three choices, assert consequence, score and debrief, then replay.
Record the first sample choice order, complete it, replay, and assert a different order.

claim: Results show attempts, accuracy, missed-choice counts, and whether the first choice improves by attempt three.
sandbox: Make three ordered sample attempts with an initial missed first choice and a strong third first choice; assert 3 attempts, 100% latest accuracy, +100% improvement, and the exact missed-choice count.

claim: Scenario photos are resized in the browser and stored in IndexedDB.
sandbox: Upload a generated 1600x800 fixture, assert a 1200x600 JPEG data URL in IndexedDB and no image localStorage key.

claim: Completed results export as CSV with one result set per attempt.
sandbox: Complete one strong and one initially missed sample attempt, parse the download, and assert two accuracy/first-choice result sets plus the aggregate misconception row.

claim: A JSON backup contains valid drill and completed-attempt fields.
sandbox: Complete the demo, export its backup, parse JSON, and assert drill and attempt fields.

claim: Import replaces current browser data only after confirmation.
sandbox: Import a valid demo fixture, accept the named replacement confirmation, and inspect the demo database.

claim: Every product screen has a real URL, concise title, exact canonical metadata, working links, route focus, and Back behavior.
sandbox: Direct-load every screen and both demo entry points; assert exact canonicals and metadata, crawl rendered links, then exercise landing-to-demo, Back, Start for real, focus, and announcements.

claim: The shipped sample is a creative-project handoff drill.
sandbox: Assert the factual sample description and opening scenario from a fresh demo.

claim: The original generated artwork source and prompt are included in the repository.
sandbox: Assert source PNG and prompt metadata exist and match the visible provenance statement.

claim: Pinned Node 20.19.0 and 22.12.0 builds write the static site to dist/index.html.
sandbox: Run Vite with Node 20.19.0 and Node 22.12.0, then assert the declared supported range, output file, and title.

claim: The shipped Static Web Apps configuration defines explicit app routes, security headers, safe caching, and a real 404 override.
sandbox: Parse source and built configuration, asserting every application route, cache rule, security header, MIME type, and the 404 override.
